readme:
# Go

Go language support from the Go team, powered by the gopls language server: diagnostics, hover with doc comments, go to definition, completion with auto-import, and format and organize imports on save.

The extension needs the Go toolchain: the `go` binary on your `PATH` (or set `go.goroot`). Get it from https://go.dev/dl/. The gopls language server is not bundled — when it is missing, the extension installs it with `go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@latest`, which takes a minute or two and needs network access the first time.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version and verified to work in Diode.

## What works in Diode

Everything gopls drives: problems in the editor and the Problems panel, hover with the doc comment of a declaration in another package, F12 to it, completion that adds the missing import, and Ctrl+S formatting the file with gofmt and dropping unused imports (the extension's own defaults for Go files). The status bar shows the Go version, `Go: Toggle Test File` switches between a file and its test, and `Go: Locate Configured Go Tools` shows what the extension found.

## What does not

Without `go` the extension stops at activation with a "Failed to find the go binary" notification and a button to the download page — the same as in VS Code. Debugging is not available: Diode has no debugger. Tests do not appear in a Testing view and there are no run test code lenses yet; run `go test` in the terminal. The welcome page and the pprof viewer are webviews, which Diode does not have.
